probes.name: silence-5120
probes.purpose: Digital silence. Per-channel normalisation maps a constant mel to 0 and the stem has no biases, so the stack input is exactly 0; an additive position term (pe_gate) would be its only input, where RoPE, the Hadamard MLPs' b2 and the zero-padded depthwise convs alone shape the rows. Under a clamp relative to the clip's peak any dither would be normalised to full scale. The lengths sweep positions up to 374.

probes.name: dc-1e-02
probes.purpose: Constant offset. Reflect centring makes every mel frame equal (the silence rows), zero centring changes the frames that reach past the clip; two levels test scale invariance.

probes.name: dc-1e-04
probes.purpose: Constant offset. Reflect centring makes every mel frame equal (the silence rows), zero centring changes the frames that reach past the clip; two levels test scale invariance.

probes.name: tone-1e-01
probes.purpose: Stationary 440 Hz tone. Interior frames normalise to 0 and the edges carry the partial-window spectrum; the leakage spans 15 decades, so 1e-1 … 1e-5 show whether an absolute floor binds anywhere.

probes.name: burst-1e-01
probes.purpose: Tone in the middle second. Each channel is two-level, so the floor decides which leakage channels carry the on/off pattern; the levels test scale invariance.

probes.name: decay
probes.purpose: Noise falling from −20 to −140 dB over 4 s: every channel crosses the floor, whose shape (hard clamp, soft knee, absolute floor) bends each channel's trajectory.

probes.name: impulse-d0-1e-01
probes.purpose: One click 0.1 at 16000 + δ: frames i see it at window index 16000 + δ − 160i + 200, so 2–3 frames sample the window at known offsets (centring and window shape); δ = 0 puts the side frames at w(40) = 0.095, 2 decades below the centre.
